description: This file contains unit tests for PKCS#8 encryption and decryption functions in BoringSSL, including tests for various encryption schemes, password handling, and round-trip encoding/decoding.

methods.name: TestDecrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a PKCS#8 encrypted private key DER with a given password and asserts success.

methods.name: TestRoundTrip
methods.description: Encrypts a sample key with specified parameters, then decrypts and verifies the key matches the original.
